description: A function defined with `async def`. Calling it runs nothing and returns a coroutine object.
A paused computation. It runs only when awaited or wrapped in a task, and warns if it is garbage collected without ever running.
Runs the awaited coroutine inline in the current task, suspending the task whenever the chain reaches something that is not ready yet.
A coroutine scheduled on the event loop with `asyncio.create_task`. It starts on the next tick, without anyone awaiting it.
Runs one step of one task at a time on one thread; a task gives up control only at an `await` that suspends.
The CPython entry point: creates a loop, runs one coroutine to completion and closes the loop. Never called from inside a running loop.
